scope: Honduras medical discovery — Universidad Nacional Autónoma de Honduras Faculty of Medical Sciences

verifiedFacts.claim: UNAH's Faculty of Medical Sciences describes its Doctor in Medicine and Surgery as an eight-year programme. Its listed entry requirements are the PHUMA score threshold, vocational test and competition for a place.

The Faculty page identifies an academic coordinator, an area coordinator for clinical training and rotating internship, and states that students undertake supervised practice in health-related institutions.

UNAH states that the Tegucigalpa Doctor in Medicine and Surgery programme holds COMAEM accreditation from 28 November 2023 to 27 November 2028; the same page says San Pedro Sula is in self-evaluation, so the Tegucigalpa status must not be generalised to another campus.

UNAH's 2026 first admission call included applicants from Honduras and foreign applicants resident inside or outside Honduras. It specified the first-cycle testing process and a L500 testing fee, but this is not programme tuition.

holdReasons: No complete, current medicine tuition and mandatory-charge schedule was located. The L500 admission-test charge cannot be represented as programme cost.
The verified call is a completed first 2026 process; a future intake needs its own live deadline, medicine-specific ranking and international-document requirements.
The source confirms supervised practice but does not identify current clinical partners, placement terms or a complete rotating-internship arrangement.
Teaching language, accommodation, scholarships/loans and detailed student-support arrangements were not verified from current authoritative sources.
nextAction: Obtain the next medicine admission calendar and official fee schedule, then verify current clinical sites, teaching language, international documentation and student support before considering a payload.
